# Spacer

Flexible space that fills the remaining space in an Inline or Stack and pushes the following elements to the
other end.

**Category**: Primitives · **Common uses**: Pushing the action buttons of a toolbar to the right

## Import

```ts
import { Spacer } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Pushes the following elements to the right inside an Inline.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Inline>
      <Text weight="semibold">Projects</Text>
      <Spacer />
      <Button>Import</Button>
      <Button variant="primary">New</Button>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

No props.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
